power_ln — 2D frequency op

• Data kinds: image → image

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "power_ln", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: power_ln (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

A stand-in for the power spectrum of a complex image. The implementation is identical to fft_generic: it applies its own FFT to the input image and returns the log of the amplitude, `log1p(|F|), normalized by its maximum (sharing the fft_power branch of _sh_freq`). a and b are unused.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

HALCON の `power_ln`（複素画像のパワースペクトルを返す演算、通常は fft_generic 等が出力した複素画像を入力に取る）とは異なり、この実装は複素入力を受け取らず実画像から自前で FFT を計算する簡略近似。fft_generic とは実装上区別がない。
